headline: EU Accuses TikTok of Promoting Harmful Mental Health Videos, Threatens Heavy Fines
summary: The European Commission has accused TikTok of creating cycles of video recommendations that are harmful to mental health, with potential fines reaching up to 6 percent of annual worldwide turnover.
why: Regulatory investigations and potential antitrust or content compliance fines pose significant legal and financial risks for major social media platforms operating in Europe.

impacts.name: ByteDance
impacts.why: Regulatory accusations and potential fines of up to 6 percent of global turnover threaten financial penalties for TikTok's parent company.
